title: Energy and Water SETA Misappropriated R58 Million on Unused Building
detail: South Africa's Energy and Water SETA (EWSETA) misappropriated R58 million in public funds on a building that was never used, according to a new report. The finding adds to growing governance and corruption concerns surrounding state entities and skills development bodies.
